quote: [CR2] answered the Isaiah 8:3-4 bound with 8:8 and 9:6-7, while [DR3] presses the sign's own bounds; the sign itself does not state the mechanism.
why: The judge weighs the defender's chain (8:8 with 9:6-7) against the challenger's chain (the sign's own bounds) rather than demanding one verse state the contrary in its own words.
